technique_name: Provide a Turing-complete definition of what a tree is.
description: A tree is a data structure composed of nodes, each of which contains data, a list of references to other nodes (child nodes), and a reference to its parent node. It is said to be Turing-complete if it can be used to represent any computable function or if it can be used to store and manipulate any data structure.
